purpose: Check adversarial decorrelation witness for unrestricted state-noise cross uncertainty; no actual physical-correlation claim
statement: If P,R are valid marginal moments and V=R-H P H^T is PSD, choose C=-P H^T and n=-H e+v with v uncorrelated with e and moment V. Innovation r=v gives posterior moment P+K V K^T for every linear correction K; no PSD-weighted trace improvement can be guaranteed over this uncertainty class.

cases: scalar R greater P admits witness
matrix nontrivial offdiagonal P/R and independent latent construction
rank-deficient P or zero V retains valid witness
stronger measurement V indefinite does not claim certificate
arbitrary fixed K cannot lower weighted trace
